overall_goal: Make cheese and butter baguette sandwiches

goals.description: Retrieve the bread knife and unpack the baguette
goals.rationale: The person gets a bread knife from the drawer, opens the baguette packaging, takes out the bread, and throws the packaging in the bin.

goals.description: Cut the baguette to size and store the remainder
goals.rationale: The person pulls out more of the baguette, cuts it to match the size of the first piece, and puts the rest back into the packaging to keep it fresh.

goals.description: Slice the baguette pieces in half for filling
goals.rationale: The person uses the bread knife to slice the baguette pieces horizontally so they can be opened up and filled.

goals.description: Retrieve butter and cheese from the fridge
goals.rationale: The person opens the fridge, takes out a tub of butter and a block of cheese, and places them on the countertop.
The person gets a butter knife, opens the tub of butter, and scrapes the butter repeatedly to soften it for spreading.

goals.description: Spread butter on the baguette pieces
goals.rationale: The person scoops butter onto the knife and spreads it evenly across the insides of the sliced baguette pieces.

goals.description: Close the butter and return it to the fridge
goals.rationale: The person puts the lid back on the butter tub, briefly handles the cheese packaging, and places the butter back into the fridge.

goals.description: Retrieve a plate from the cupboard
goals.rationale: The person opens a cupboard, takes out a plate, and clears space on the countertop to set it down.

goals.description: Slice the cheese and fill the baguettes
goals.rationale: The person takes the cheese out of its packet, slices it with the butter knife, and lays the slices inside the buttered baguettes before closing them.

goals.description: Return the cheese to the fridge
goals.rationale: The person puts the remaining cheese back into its packaging, folds it shut, and places it back into the fridge.
